name: RustSMF
_note: Dev controller button layout. Groups become tabs. .tools/ and generators are for human devs + LLM skills only — keep context lean by using summary_bank.json + _gen_struct.py / get-context.ps1 instead of broad reads of old-src, node_modules, or .tools internals. See docs/dev/APP_STATE.md, docs/dev/TODO.md, docs/dev/PITFALL_LEDGER.md, and .agents/ for current conversion directions.

buttons.label: Dump Default Structure
buttons.description: Generates focused structure output from the current summary bank groups (preferred over full tree for LLM sessions).

buttons.label: Sync Summary Bank
buttons.description: Scans the repo for new or moved files and updates summary_bank.json without dropping custom groups. Run after adding loaders, UI panels, or Rust commands.

buttons.label: Edit Summary Bank
buttons.description: Opens summary_bank.json in your default text editor. Curate narrow groups for smf_format, three_viewport, tauri_bridge, harness, etc.

buttons.label: Project Setup / Install
buttons.description: Installs npm workspace (source/frontend), Playwright browsers, and any Cargo deps for the Tauri shell. Prepares for web + desktop dev.

buttons.label: Start Web Dev
buttons.description: Launches Vite dev server for the Three.js + React frontend (browser-runnable 3D editor). Use for quick iteration on viewport, loaders, timeline.

buttons.label: Start Desktop (Tauri)
buttons.description: Launches Tauri dev shell around the same frontend. Adds native file dialogs + binary FS for SMF/GLB/FBX workflows.

buttons.label: Compile Desktop
buttons.description: Builds the packaged Tauri desktop app (nsis etc) from the current frontend build.

buttons.label: Verify Repo
buttons.description: Runs lint, type checks, unit tests, frontend build + entry chunk checks, cargo check, and basic integrity in one sweep.

buttons.label: Run E2E Tests
buttons.description: Executes the Playwright suite (viewport load, model import, skeleton/anim playback, export flows, screenshots of 3D states).

buttons.label: Desktop Smoke
buttons.description: Builds (no-bundle), boots the desktop app, exercises basic native commands + 3D smoke (load small model, check no crash).

buttons.label: Push (Auto-Creates Repo)
buttons.description: Commits all changes and pushes. Creates a private GitHub repo if one doesn't exist.

buttons.label: Pull / Sync
buttons.description: Fetches and rebases or merges from the remote repository.
